description: Angular component for managing a default mobile page panel, including form handling, state updates, and interactions with popover UI.

classes.name: DefaultMobilePagePanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing a mobile page panel, including form controls and state logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up form values, and subscriptions.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Hides the popover without applying changes.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Emits the current page item as applied.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Resets form values to default or hidden state and updates the model.

methods.name: updateCleanupState
methods.description: Updates the cleanup enabled state based on current form and page item properties.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Synchronizes form values with the page item model.
